fee_plans_due_day_check.name: fee_plans_due_day_check
fee_plans_due_day_check.value: ("fee_plans"."cycle" = 'one_time' and "fee_plans"."due_day" is null) or ("fee_plans"."cycle" <> 'one_time' and "fee_plans"."due_day" is not null and "fee_plans"."due_day" between 1 and 28)

fee_plans_late_fee_check.name: fee_plans_late_fee_check
fee_plans_late_fee_check.value: ("fee_plans"."late_fee_paise" is null and "fee_plans"."late_fee_after_days" is null) or ("fee_plans"."late_fee_paise" is not null and "fee_plans"."late_fee_after_days" is not null and "fee_plans"."late_fee_paise" between 1 and "fee_plans"."amount_paise" and "fee_plans"."late_fee_after_days" between 1 and 60)

invoices_waived_check.name: invoices_waived_check
invoices_waived_check.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'waived' or ("invoices"."waived_at" is not null and "invoices"."waive_reason" is not null and length(trim("invoices"."waive_reason")) > 0)
